title: plagiobothrys collinus var. ursinus
intro: Plagiobothrys collinus var. ursinus, commonly known as Ursa-leaved popcorn flower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Boraginaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Plagiobothrys collinus var. ursinus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
